_about: Vostok v0.11 evening and rain (maps 272-275): the environment probes' diffuse and specular light times four (diffuse evening 1 -> 4, rain 0.7 -> 2.8; specular 1 -> 4), nothing else. The probe cubes are 0.11e's own, byte for byte; 0.11e lights a probe texel as (c/a)^2.2, 0.26g's probe program as (c/a)^2 / 4 (its diffuse and specular taps both scale by 0.25), so four gives the probes 0.11e's light (docs/notes/v011-weather.md, "The darkness"). Measured against 0.11e at ten views a weather (with exe patch 162's sky, fog and skylight): evening display RMSE 0.153 -> 0.142, rain 0.0905 -> 0.0894, near-black pixels 16% -> 9% and 25% -> 17% (0.11e: 4% and 7%). It replaces the factor three (diffuse only) measured on 2026-11-12, before the fog and sky were 0.11e's.
